question_ne: A, B को भाइ हो। B, C की आमा हो। C, D की बहिनी हो। D, A को के नाता पर्छ?
explanation_ne: B, A की दिदीबहिनी र C तथा D की आमा हुन्, त्यसैले D, A को भान्जा वा भान्जी हो।

question: Sita is the mother of Ram. Ram is the father of Gita. How is Sita related to Gita?
explanation: Sita is the mother of Gita's father, so Sita is Gita's grandmother.
question_ne: सीता रामकी आमा हुन्। राम गीताका बुबा हुन्। सीता गीताकी के नाता पर्छिन्?
explanation_ne: सीता गीताका बुबाकी आमा हुन्, त्यसैले सीता गीताकी हजुरआमा हुन्।

question: A man says, 'My mother's only son is the father of this boy.' How is the boy related to the man?
explanation: The man's mother's only son is the man himself, so the boy's father is the man — the boy is his son.
question_ne: एक जना मानिस भन्छन्, 'मेरी आमाको एक मात्र छोरा यस केटाका बुबा हुन्।' केटा त्यस मानिसको के नाता पर्छ?
explanation_ne: मानिसकी आमाको एक मात्र छोरा उनी आफैँ हुन्, त्यसैले केटाका बुबा उनी हुन् — केटा उनको छोरा हो।

question: P is the son of Q. Q is the sister of R. R is the father of S. How is P related to S?
explanation: Q and R are siblings; P is Q's son and S is R's child, so P and S are cousins.
question_ne: P, Q को छोरा हो। Q, R की बहिनी हो। R, S को बुबा हो। P, S को के नाता पर्छ?
explanation_ne: Q र R दाजुभाइ-दिदीबहिनी हुन्; P, Q को छोरा र S, R को सन्तान हो, त्यसैले P र S चचेरा भाइबहिनी हुन्।

question: X is the father of Y. Y is the sister of Z. Z is the son of W. How is W related to X?
explanation: Y and Z are siblings and children of X and W, so W is X's wife (the children's mother).
question_ne: X, Y को बुबा हो। Y, Z की बहिनी हो। Z, W को छोरा हो। W, X को के नाता पर्छिन्?
explanation_ne: Y र Z दाजुभाइ-दिदीबहिनी हुन् र X तथा W का सन्तान हुन्, त्यसैले W, X की श्रीमती हुन्।

question: A girl introduces a boy as the son of the only daughter of her grandmother. How is the boy related to the girl?
explanation: The grandmother's only daughter is the girl's mother, so the mother's son is the girl's brother.
question_ne: एउटी केटीले एउटा केटालाई आफ्नी हजुरआमाकी एक मात्र छोरीको छोरा भनेर परिचय गराउँछिन्। केटा केटीको के नाता पर्छ?
explanation_ne: हजुरआमाकी एक मात्र छोरी केटीकी आमा हुन्, त्यसैले आमाको छोरा केटीको भाइ हो।

question: M is the brother of N. N is the wife of O. O is the son of P. How is M related to P?
explanation: N is P's daughter-in-law (O's wife), so N's brother M is P's son-in-law.
question_ne: M, N को भाइ हो। N, O की श्रीमती हो। O, P को छोरा हो। M, P को के नाता पर्छ?
explanation_ne: N, P की बुहारी हुन् (O की श्रीमती), त्यसैले N का भाइ M, P का ज्वाइँ हुन्।

question: If A + B means A is the father of B, A − B means A is the sister of B, and A × B means A is the brother of B, what does P + Q − R mean?
options: Q is the father of R
P is the father of Q and R
P is the brother of Q
P is the son of R
explanation: P + Q means P is the father of Q; Q − R means Q is the sister of R. So P is the father of both Q and R.
question_ne: यदि A + B को अर्थ A, B को बुबा हो, A − B को अर्थ A, B की बहिनी हो र A × B को अर्थ A, B को भाइ हो भने P + Q − R को अर्थ के हो?
options_ne: P, Q र R दुवैका बुबा हुन्
explanation_ne: P + Q को अर्थ P, Q को बुबा हो; Q − R को अर्थ Q, R की बहिनी हो। त्यसैले P, Q र R दुवैका बुबा हुन्।

question: Ramesh's father's sister's daughter's brother is Ramesh's what?
explanation: Ramesh's father's sister is his aunt; her children are Ramesh's cousins, including her son.
question_ne: रमेशका बुबाकी बहिनीकी छोरीको भाइ रमेशको के नाता पर्छ?
explanation_ne: रमेशका बुबाकी बहिनी उनको फुपू हुन्; उनका सन्तान रमेशका चचेरा भाइबहिनी हुन्, छोरा पनि।

question: A is the mother of B. B is the brother of C. C is the father of D. How is A related to D?
explanation: A is the mother of B and C; C is D's father, so A is D's grandmother.
question_ne: A, B की आमा हुन्। B, C को भाइ हो। C, D को बुबा हो। A, D की के नाता पर्छिन्?
explanation_ne: A, B र C की आमा हुन्; C, D को बुबा हो, त्यसैले A, D की हजुरआमा हुन्।

question: S is the daughter of T. T is the wife of U. U is the brother of V. How is S related to V?
explanation: S is the daughter of T and U; U is V's brother, so S is V's niece.
question_ne: S, T की छोरी हो। T, U की श्रीमती हो। U, V को भाइ हो। S, V की के नाता पर्छिन्?
explanation_ne: S, T र U की छोरी हो; U, V को भाइ हो, त्यसैले S, V की भतिजी हो।

question: Pointing to a man, Anil says, 'His mother is the only daughter of my mother.' How is the man related to Anil?
explanation: Anil's mother's only daughter is Anil's sister; her son is Anil's nephew.
question_ne: एक जना मानिसलाई देखाउँदै अनिल भन्छन्, 'उनकी आमा मेरी आमाकी एक मात्र छोरी हुन्।' ती मानिस अनिलको के नाता पर्छन्?
explanation_ne: अनिलकी आमाकी एक मात्र छोरी अनिलकी बहिनी हुन्; उनकी छोरा अनिलको भान्जा हो।

question: K is the husband of L. L is the sister of M. M is the father of N. How is K related to N?
explanation: L is N's aunt (M's sister), so L's husband K is N's uncle.
question_ne: K, L को श्रीमान् हो। L, M की बहिनी हो। M, N को बुबा हो। K, N को के नाता पर्छ?
explanation_ne: L, N की फुपू हुन् (M की बहिनी), त्यसैले L का श्रीमान् K, N का काका हुन्।

question: Statements: All pens are books. All books are bags. Conclusions: I. All pens are bags. II. Some bags are pens.
explanation: All pens are books and all books are bags, so all pens are bags (I). Since all pens are bags, some bags are pens (II).
question_ne: कथनहरू: सबै कलमहरू किताब हुन्। सबै किताबहरू झोला हुन्। निष्कर्षहरू: I. सबै कलमहरू झोला हुन्। II. केही झोलाहरू कलम हुन्।
options_ne: I र II दुवै मान्य छन्
explanation_ne: सबै कलम किताब र सबै किताब झोला भएकाले सबै कलम झोला हुन् (I)। सबै कलम झोला भएकाले केही झोला कलम हुन् (II)।

question: Statements: Some cats are dogs. All dogs are animals. Conclusions: I. Some cats are animals. II. All cats are animals.
explanation: Some cats are dogs and all dogs are animals, so those cats are animals (I). But not all cats need be dogs, so II does not follow.
question_ne: कथनहरू: केही बिरालाहरू कुकुर हुन्। सबै कुकुरहरू जनावर हुन्। निष्कर्षहरू: I. केही बिरालाहरू जनावर हुन्। II. सबै बिरालाहरू जनावर हुन्।
explanation_ne: केही बिराला कुकुर र सबै कुकुर जनावर भएकाले ती बिराला जनावर हुन् (I)। तर सबै बिराला कुकुर हुनुपर्दैन, त्यसैले II मान्य छैन।

question: Statements: No pen is a pencil. All pencils are erasers. Conclusions: I. No pen is an eraser. II. Some erasers are pencils.
explanation: No pen is a pencil, but erasers include all pencils plus possibly pens — I does not follow. All pencils are erasers, so some erasers are pencils (II).
question_ne: कथनहरू: कुनै पनि कलम पेन्सिल होइन। सबै पेन्सिलहरू इरेजर हुन्। निष्कर्षहरू: I. कुनै पनि कलम इरेजर होइन। II. केही इरेजरहरू पेन्सिल हुन्।
explanation_ne: कुनै कलम पेन्सिल होइन, तर इरेजरमा सबै पेन्सिल र सम्भवतः कलम पनि पर्छन् — I मान्य छैन। सबै पेन्सिल इरेजर भएकाले केही इरेजर पेन्सिल हुन् (II)।

question: Statements: All students are hardworking. Some hardworking people are successful. Conclusions: I. Some students are successful. II. All successful people are students.
explanation: The 'some hardworking people' who are successful need not be students, so I does not follow; II reverses the relation and does not follow either.
question_ne: कथनहरू: सबै विद्यार्थीहरू मेहनती छन्। केही मेहनती मानिसहरू सफल छन्। निष्कर्षहरू: I. केही विद्यार्थीहरू सफल छन्। II. सबै सफल मानिसहरू विद्यार्थी हुन्।
explanation_ne: सफल हुने 'केही मेहनती मानिसहरू' विद्यार्थी हुनैपर्दैन, त्यसैले I मान्य छैन; II ले सम्बन्ध उल्ट्याउँछ, त्यो पनि मान्य छैन।

question: Statements: Some mangoes are sweet. All sweet things are fruits. Conclusions: I. Some mangoes are fruits. II. All mangoes are sweet.
explanation: The sweet mangoes are fruits (I), but the statements say only some mangoes are sweet, so II does not follow.
question_ne: कथनहरू: केही आँपहरू गुलिया छन्। सबै गुलिया चिजहरू फल हुन्। निष्कर्षहरू: I. केही आँपहरू फल हुन्। II. सबै आँपहरू गुलिया छन्।
explanation_ne: गुलिया आँपहरू फल हुन् (I), तर कथनमा केही आँप मात्र गुलिया भनिएको छ, त्यसैले II मान्य छैन।

question: Statements: All birds can fly. Penguins are birds. Conclusions: I. Penguins can fly. II. Some birds cannot fly.
explanation: As a formal syllogism, all birds can fly and penguins are birds, so penguins can fly (I). II contradicts the first statement, so it does not follow.
question_ne: कथनहरू: सबै चराहरू उड्न सक्छन्। पेन्गुइनहरू चरा हुन्। निष्कर्षहरू: I. पेन्गुइनहरू उड्न सक्छन्। II. केही चराहरू उड्न सक्दैनन्।
explanation_ne: औपचारिक तर्कमा सबै चरा उड्न सक्छन् र पेन्गुइन चरा भएकाले पेन्गुइन उड्न सक्छन् (I)। II ले पहिलो कथनको विरोध गर्छ, त्यसैले मान्य छैन।

question: Statements: No teacher is a student. Some students are singers. Conclusions: I. Some singers are not teachers. II. No singer is a teacher.
explanation: The students who are singers are not teachers, so some singers are not teachers (I). But singers who are not students could be teachers, so II does not follow.
question_ne: कथनहरू: कुनै पनि शिक्षक विद्यार्थी होइन। केही विद्यार्थीहरू गायक हुन्। निष्कर्षहरू: I. केही गायकहरू शिक्षक होइनन्। II. कुनै पनि गायक शिक्षक होइन।
explanation_ne: गायक भएका विद्यार्थीहरू शिक्षक होइनन्, त्यसैले केही गायक शिक्षक होइनन् (I)। तर विद्यार्थी नभएका गायक शिक्षक हुन सक्छन्, त्यसैले II मान्य छैन।

question: Statements: All roses are flowers. Some flowers are red. Conclusions: I. Some roses are red. II. All red things are flowers.
explanation: The red flowers need not be roses, so I does not follow; and red things outside flowers are not excluded, so II does not follow.
question_ne: कथनहरू: सबै गुलाबहरू फूल हुन्। केही फूलहरू रातो छन्। निष्कर्षहरू: I. केही गुलाबहरू रातो छन्। II. सबै रातो चिजहरू फूल हुन्।
explanation_ne: रातो फूलहरू गुलाब हुनैपर्दैन, त्यसैले I मान्य छैन; फूलबाहिरका रातो चिजहरू पनि हुन सक्छन्, त्यसैले II मान्य छैन।

question: Statements: Some chairs are tables. All tables are furniture. Conclusions: I. Some chairs are furniture. II. Some furniture is chairs.
explanation: The chairs that are tables are furniture (I), and 'some chairs are furniture' converts to 'some furniture is chairs' (II).
question_ne: कथनहरू: केही कुर्सीहरू टेबल हुन्। सबै टेबलहरू फर्निचर हुन्। निष्कर्षहरू: I. केही कुर्सीहरू फर्निचर हुन्। II. केही फर्निचर कुर्सी हो।
options_ne: I र II दुवै मान्य छन्
explanation_ne: टेबल भएका कुर्सीहरू फर्निचर हुन् (I), र 'केही कुर्सी फर्निचर हुन्' भन्ने कुरा 'केही फर्निचर कुर्सी हो' मा बदलिन्छ (II)।

question: Statements: All doctors are educated. Some educated people are rich. Conclusions: I. Some doctors are rich. II. All rich people are educated.
explanation: The rich educated people need not be doctors, so I does not follow; II also does not follow from 'some educated people are rich'.
question_ne: कथनहरू: सबै डाक्टरहरू शिक्षित छन्। केही शिक्षित मानिसहरू धनी छन्। निष्कर्षहरू: I. केही डाक्टरहरू धनी छन्। II. सबै धनी मानिसहरू शिक्षित छन्।
explanation_ne: धनी शिक्षित मानिसहरू डाक्टर हुनैपर्दैन, त्यसैले I मान्य छैन; 'केही शिक्षित मानिस धनी छन्' बाट II पनि मान्य हुँदैन।

question: Statements: No fish is a bird. Some birds are black. Conclusions: I. Some black things are not fish. II. All black things are birds.
explanation: The black birds are not fish, so some black things are not fish (I). Black things need not be birds, so II does not follow.
question_ne: कथनहरू: कुनै पनि माछा चरा होइन। केही चराहरू कालो छन्। निष्कर्षहरू: I. केही कालो चिजहरू माछा होइनन्। II. सबै कालो चिजहरू चरा हुन्।
explanation_ne: कालो चराहरू माछा होइनन्, त्यसैले केही कालो चिज माछा होइनन् (I)। कालो चिज चरा हुनैपर्दैन, त्यसैले II मान्य छैन।

question: Statements: All squares are rectangles. All rectangles are polygons. Conclusions: I. All squares are polygons. II. Some polygons are squares.
explanation: All squares are rectangles and all rectangles are polygons, so all squares are polygons (I); hence some polygons are squares (II).
question_ne: कथनहरू: सबै वर्गहरू आयत हुन्। सबै आयतहरू बहुभुज हुन्। निष्कर्षहरू: I. सबै वर्गहरू बहुभुज हुन्। II. केही बहुभुजहरू वर्ग हुन्।
options_ne: I र II दुवै मान्य छन्
explanation_ne: सबै वर्ग आयत र सबै आयत बहुभुज भएकाले सबै वर्ग बहुभुज हुन् (I); त्यसैले केही बहुभुज वर्ग हुन् (II)।

question: Statements: Some engineers are managers. No manager is a clerk. Conclusions: I. Some engineers are not clerks. II. No engineer is a clerk.
explanation: The engineers who are managers are not clerks (I). But engineers who are not managers could be clerks, so II does not follow.
question_ne: कथनहरू: केही इन्जिनियरहरू प्रबन्धक हुन्। कुनै पनि प्रबन्धक क्लर्क होइन। निष्कर्षहरू: I. केही इन्जिनियरहरू क्लर्क होइनन्। II. कुनै पनि इन्जिनियर क्लर्क होइन।
explanation_ne: प्रबन्धक भएका इन्जिनियरहरू क्लर्क होइनन् (I)। तर प्रबन्धक नभएका इन्जिनियर क्लर्क हुन सक्छन्, त्यसैले II मान्य छैन।

question: Statements: All mothers are women. Some women are teachers. Conclusions: I. Some mothers are teachers. II. All teachers are women.
explanation: The women who are teachers need not be mothers, so I does not follow; and teachers include men, so II does not follow.
question_ne: कथनहरू: सबै आमाहरू महिला हुन्। केही महिलाहरू शिक्षक हुन्। निष्कर्षहरू: I. केही आमाहरू शिक्षक हुन्। II. सबै शिक्षकहरू महिला हुन्।
explanation_ne: शिक्षक भएका महिलाहरू आमा हुनैपर्दैन, त्यसैले I मान्य छैन; शिक्षकमा पुरुष पनि हुन्छन्, त्यसैले II मान्य छैन।

question: Statements: No honest person is corrupt. All politicians are honest. Conclusions: I. No politician is corrupt. II. Some corrupt people are politicians.
explanation: All politicians are honest and no honest person is corrupt, so no politician is corrupt (I). II contradicts I, so it does not follow.
